rule.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance tenant screening and source-of-income protection
rule.requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents may use any reasonable standard to select applicants only if it is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants, and housing discrimination based on source of income, including Section 8 and public benefits, is prohibited.
rule.coverage_conditions: Housing and real estate transactions in Cambridge; owner-occupied two-family dwellings are exempt.
rule.exemptions: Two-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
rule.penalty: Civil fines of up to $300 for each violation; damages, expenses and other relief after a public hearing.

rule.title: Cambridge Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance
rule.requirement: Landlords and management companies must give tenants the Tenants Rights and Resources Guide at the start of a tenancy and when legal steps to terminate a tenancy are taken, such as a notice to quit.
rule.coverage_conditions: All residential rental agreements in Cambridge, including single dwelling units and tenancies at will; the Ordinance does not restrict when a landlord may evict.
rule.exemptions: Units in a hospital, skilled nursing or health facility; non-profit facilities whose primary purpose is short-term alcohol, drug or substance-abuse treatment; short-term rental units under the zoning ordinance.
rule.penalty: Fine of $300 for each day's violation.
rule.quoted_span: The Ordinance requires owners, landlords, and management companies to provide you with information at the start of your lease or tenancy as well as when your tenancy is being terminated.
